reviewer_note: 個個 is a distributive quantifier; 都係噉講 means each person says it like that. The repeated-looking form is not the manner modifier.

text: 符符碌碌噉俾你哋贏咗吖嗎.
previous_text: 分分鐘代表公司出賽,第時攞埋冠軍.
reviewer_note: 符符碌碌 is a Cantonese luck/fluke expression and here directly precedes 噉 + 俾你哋贏咗 as the manner of the event.
parser_implication: Supports an overt marked reduplicated-manner relation, but not open-class AABB productivity.

text: 但係始終都係望落去就大大隻隻噉喇就覺得佢.
reviewer_note: 大大隻隻噉 is a descriptive property predicate after 望落去; 喇 closes that predication before 就覺得. It is not the manner of 覺得.
parser_implication: Keep marked reduplicated property predication distinct from AA84 action-VP modification.

text: 噉𠻺係,你啱啱新牌又揸架c.c.咁大嘅.
previous_text: 唔知啊,唔想買架千六囖,佢話.
reviewer_note: c.c. is an orthographic acronym/measure expression, not reduplication; 咁大 is a degree predicate.
parser_implication: Exclude punctuation-bearing acronym repetition from reduplicative-manner analysis.

text: 但係而家唔知係唔係呢因為朝頭早起身呢太早啊,又要日日都咁早起身呢.
reviewer_note: 日日 is a temporal-frequency quantifier and 都咁早 describes degree/time; it does not modify 起身 as a reduplicated manner expression.

text: 噉又唔知點解嗱嗱臨噉呢攞啲錢出來喎.
previous_text: 跟住我哋都依然不以為意,噉佢於-於是乎,但係我又唔係好明點解佢問我哋邊度有錢暢囖.
next_text: 跟住呢,就有兩個話係佢哋係警察嘅人呢就走埋來囖,噉,於是乎話我哋非法喺度暢錢喎.
reviewer_note: 嗱嗱臨 is an established Cantonese adverb meaning hurriedly; 嗱嗱臨噉 modifies 攞啲錢出來, with discourse particle 呢 intervening before the verb.
parser_implication: Supports the marked manner relation lexically, but does not validate a strict marker-immediately-before-VP span when a discourse particle intervenes.

text: 諗住呢,死死氣噉返屋企喇噉樣喇,冇行喇.
reviewer_note: 死死氣 is an adverbial expression meaning reluctantly/dejectedly; 死死氣噉 directly modifies 返屋企.
parser_implication: Supports an overt marked reduplicated-manner relation, but not open-class repeated-prefix productivity.

text: 嗱,第一次搬𠻺搬咗之後就-就遠咗少少咁多.
previous_text: 你應該一次過搬去屯門吖嗎應該.
next_text: 跟住而家搬咗荃灣都唔係真係遠得幾多咋喎,話時話.
reviewer_note: 少少咁多 expresses a small amount/extent; 咁 links a degree comparison rather than a manner modifier.
parser_implication: Keep quantity/extent uses of 少少 + 咁 outside AA84.

text: 即係唔係間間會噉做,不過,不過,因為你相機可能傳統上好多人都唔識用喇,因為啲傻瓜機好難用𡃉好多都.
reviewer_note: 間間 is distributive over shops/cameras; 會噉做 means will do it like that. The repeated-looking quantifier is not the manner expression.
parser_implication: Do not connect a distributive repeated quantifier across a modal to the following 噉 + VP relation.

text: 年年都係噉打電話俾佢𡃉喇.
reviewer_note: 年年 is temporal frequency; 都係噉打電話 means call like that every year. The repeated form does not supply manner.
parser_implication: Keep temporal-frequency reduplication distinct from a separate 噉 + VP manner/demonstrative relation.
